title: Brainy: use documented data.transcript_path instead of reconstructing the transcript path (retires cp-d9g guesswork)
description: HD-R1.1. Claude Code passes the conversation transcript file path on stdin as the DOCUMENTED common input field data.transcript_path (Hooks reference, Common input fields, guaranteed every event). Brainy instead reconstructs it by transforming cwd via a homemade encoding (lib/transcript-dir.js, the cp-d9g machinery + 'discover dont construct' caveat); session-auto-close.js:280 even does it from process.cwd() (the cp-jmx bug). Fix: read data.transcript_path directly in session-auto-close.js, session-export-qmd.js, session-auto-track.js; keep transcript-dir.js only as a fallback when the field is absent. Effect: deletes the whole 'guessed the path wrong' bug class instead of patching it; makes cp-jmx largely moot (supersedes it — close cp-jmx as part of this or scope cp-jmx down to the fallback). Verify data.transcript_path presence on Stop/SessionEnd/SessionStart stdin during the cp-068 instrumented run before removing the fallback. Ref: Brainy Verification.md HD-R1.1.

title: Brainy: session-end.js is async:true — final session close lost on Ctrl+D process exit (stale active sessions)
description: HD-SE (user-surfaced 2026-05-17). hooks.json registers session-end.js with async:true. Content is safe (session-auto-close.js is sync on every Stop) but the FINAL close — status active->done, ended: timestamp, bd prime — lives only in the async SessionEnd hook. On /clear the CLI process survives so it completes; on Ctrl+D Ctrl+D the process exits immediately and the detached async hook is killed before its fs write + 5s bd prime -> session note stuck status:active, no ended: -> next SessionStart sees a stale active session. This is the likely ROOT CAUSE of the recurring stale-session class cp-re1 sweep was created to mop up (cp-re1 = band-aid, this = source). Fix: make session-end.js synchronous (drop async:true); work is tiny (one regex replace + write + 5s-capped bd prime). Related: cp-9kw (StopFailure), cp-re1 (sweep). Confirm test: create session, Ctrl+D x2, inspect note frontmatter before relaunch (status still active = confirmed) vs /clear (status done). Ledger: Brainy Verification.md HD-SE.

Candidate root cause of 'no Claude Code tasks/TaskNotes' symptom. Fix: emit JSON hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext. Also adopt SessionStart data.source (HD-4.7). BLOCKED until HD-VERIFY confirms. Ledger HD-4.1.

title: Brainy SessionEnd close never fires on abandoned sessions
description: Across both brainy-web build transcripts the SessionEnd hook fired 0x though configured in hooks.json. Session note left status:active / ended:null indefinitely; no reconciliation path for sessions that are killed/abandoned rather than ended cleanly. Auto-maintenance (Stop) worked; close did not. Fix: a reconciliation pass that closes stale active sessions (e.g. on next SessionStart, age out active notes with no recent activity).
close_reason: Fixed + merged PR #27. Global sweepStaleActiveSessions() on every SessionStart, mtime-keyed; tested 24h/7h/now boundaries + self-test 107/0; live-reconciled the abandoned brainy-web session.

title: Brainy has no commit-on-main guard (only push)
description: check-no-main-push.js is gated 'if: Bash(git push *)' so it is a PUSH guard only. The brainy-web autonomous build ran 'git checkout --orphan main && git commit' (local, never pushed) with zero PreToolUse intervention. Global rule + PRD AC both require branch-first; nothing enforces it for commits. Fix: add a commit-on-main / orphan-main guard (warn or block git commit when HEAD is main/master, and on git checkout --orphan main/master).
close_reason: Fixed + merged PR #26. Guard now blocks commit-on-main, --orphan main/master, plus existing push protections; hooks.json gate broadened; opt-out env; 8/8 tests + self-test 107/0.

title: prd-seed is not atomic: interrupt leaves PRD seeded:true with incomplete backlog + guard blocks recovery
description: Observed live 2026-05-16: a brainy-driven session ran prd-seed for 'Brainy Web' (13 acceptance criteria) and was interrupted. Result: PRD frontmatter set to seeded:true / seeded_count:13 but only 2 of 13 bd issues were actually created in the project. Worse: the seeded:true guard then PREVENTS re-seeding, so the project is permanently stuck with a silently-incomplete backlog the system believes is complete — no self-detection, no recovery. Manual reset (seeded:false + delete partial issues + re-seed) was required. Proper fix: prd-seed must be transactional/atomic — only flip seeded:true (+ seeded_count/at) AFTER all bd creates succeed; on failure/interrupt leave seeded:false and roll back or make re-run idempotent; and/or validate seeded_count against actual bd issue count and self-heal. Found by the Brainy Verification exercise.
close_reason: prd-seed.mjs now verifies persistence by re-querying the target repo (bd list -l prd:<name> --json, cwd=repoDir) instead of trusting bd create exit codes; seeded_count = verified actual count. Hard-abort re-seed guard removed and replaced with idempotent reconciliation (creates only missing acceptance criteria by title). seeded:true written ONLY when verified count===items.length; partial seed leaves seeded:false + non-zero exit + clear warning so it is re-runnable with no duplicates. --dry-run and path/folder/.beads guards unchanged. Sandbox-verified 4 scenarios (partial->seeded:false/exit1; re-run fills gap no dupes; complete re-run no-op; clean full seed verified count); brainy-self-test 107/0. PR #22 (fix/prd-seed-atomic, NOT merged, awaiting user approval).

title: check-beads-init auto-init is incomplete: no git hooks / no agent doc / uncommitted config — projects come up dirty in bd doctor
description: brainy/hooks/check-beads-init.js auto-runs 'bd init --shared-server --external -p <name> --skip-agents --skip-hooks --non-interactive' on SessionStart for code projects. Result: every fresh brainy project shows bd doctor warnings — (a) NO git hooks installed (bd's pre-commit/post-merge/pre-push that keep .beads/issues.jsonl synced — this is the ROOT CAUSE of the recurring .beads/issues.jsonl merge conflicts hit on PRs #12/#15/#19 this session), (b) NO agent documentation (bd workflow doc; claude-plugins has AGENTS.md so it doesn't warn there), (c) bd config left uncommitted post-init. Proper fix (no workaround): after the existing bd init, also run the documented 'bd hooks install' + 'bd setup claude' + commit the config, so brainy's existing auto-init leaves a CLEAN project. Must investigate WHY --skip-hooks/--skip-agents were added (code comments lines 44-49 + git history) before changing, and not break brainy's own Claude Code hooks or the shared-server/--external rationale.
close_reason: check-beads-init.js now runs bd hooks install + minimal AGENTS.md (only if no agent doc) + bd vc commit after a successful auto-init, at the single success site (line ~235); displayed command block also updated. --skip-agents/--skip-hooks kept intentionally (bd init defaults would clobber project CLAUDE.md/.claude/settings.json; bd's git hooks != brainy CC event hooks). Sandbox bd doctor: 3 target warnings gone (Git Hooks, Agent Documentation, config-modified); 2 expected (No remotes, Phantom beads_global) left alone. Idempotent: re-fire early-exits clean. Self-test 107/0.

title: S-1: session-auto-track getRecentTranscriptContext() hardcodes C--Users-HamCh-code-<folder>
description:
session-auto-track.js:376 builds the Claude Code transcript dir as the LITERAL string `C--Users-HamCh-code-${folderName}` — hardcoding (a) the username HamCh and (b) the ~/code layout. For any other user, any non-~/code project location, or a differently-encoded cwd, fs.existsSync(transcriptDir) is false so getRecentTranscriptContext() returns null and NO recent-session transcript context is ever injected at SessionStart. This is the S-1 recall-loop breakpoint: a brand-new session cannot recover prior conversational context for the project.

NOT a ~/code-gate (so it was correctly out of the cp-wp2 hook-gate sweep) and NOT a projects-root-layout issue (so it is NOT covered by cp-qr9). Distinct problem: transcript-dir path ENCODING.

Correct approach already exists in-repo: session-auto-close.js:145 findCwdProjectsDir(cwd) derives the dir by encoding the actual cwd (cwd.replace(/[:\\\/]+/g, '-')). Fix = derive the encoded transcript dir from the SESSION cwd (sessionDir) via the same encoding, NOT a hardcoded string. MUST preserve session-auto-track's 3-mode behavior (vault context injection in vault/workspace sessions must keep working — only the code-session transcript-recall path changes). Needs dedicated design + tests; do NOT bundle into PR #12. Found during cp-wp2 close-gap audit.
close_reason: DONE — PR #15 (fix/session-auto-track-transcript-encoding, base master, NOT merged). New shared hooks/lib/transcript-dir.js with encoding VERIFIED against real ~/.claude/projects/ dirs (every non-[A-Za-z0-9-] char → '-', no collapse, no trim). getRecentTranscriptContext() now encodes the session cwd via the helper — no more hardcoded C--Users-HamCh-code-<folder>. Also fixed a latent bug: session-auto-close.js findCwdProjectsDir used a DIFFERENT wrong algo (/[:\/]+/g collapse+trim → C-Users-... never matched real C--Users-...); routed it through the shared helper. 3-mode behavior preserved (verified: vault session → AUTO-CONTEXT(Vault), no transcript block). Tests: hooks/lib/transcript-dir.test.js 12 ground-truthed assertions + non-~/code fs sandbox; wired into brainy-self-test. self-test 104/0 exit 0. Real claude-plugins transcript dir resolves end-to-end.

title: is-code-context false-positives on a git-backed Obsidian vault (.git but no manifest)
description: CRITICAL: the user's Obsidian vault is itself a git repo (vault backup commits). findCodeRoot() treats .git as a corroborating signal, so findCodeRoot(vaultRoot) returns the vault as a code context. Net effect: EVERY vault session is classified as a code session — defeating the entire ~/code-universalization for this (the primary) user. Verifier-flagged hazard 1 (check-beads-init auto-init in vault session) is a direct symptom. Fix: treat a directory containing .obsidian/ (or any ancestor with one) as a non-code excluded root in is-code-context.js, same class as $HOME/fs-root. .obsidian unambiguously marks an Obsidian vault.
close_reason: Fixed: added isInsideObsidianVault() to lib/is-code-context.js; findCodeRoot() short-circuits to null when start dir is at/under any ancestor containing .obsidian/, BEFORE the manifest/corroborating(.git) checks. Verified on the user's REAL git-backed vault: findCodeRoot(vault)=null, findCodeRoot(code proj)=unchanged, findCodeRoot(package.json subdir INSIDE a vault)=null. Closes verifier hazards: (1) check-beads-init no longer auto-inits/nags in a vault-anchored session; (2) beads-work-surface emits neither stdout nor the [brainy] stderr banner in a vault session (gate exits before any write) while still firing in a real code session. Self-test 101/101; 0 leaks across 15 gated hooks; F-9.1 still blocks.

title: REQUIRED: eliminate ~/code projects-root assumption from PRD subsystem (schema + scripts)
description:
REQUIRED (user directive: zero ~/code assumptions anywhere — hundreds of users
have no ~/code, so any such logic is a guaranteed failure). This is the LAST
remaining ~/code assumption after the PR #12 hook sweep. Promoted P3 -> P1.

## Root cause is DESIGN-LEVEL, not just 3 scripts

The PRD subsystem's data model itself hardcodes ~/code as the PRD<->repo join:

- skills/prd/SKILL.md:43  -> `folder: <slug>   # MUST match ~/code/<slug>/ — the join key`
- skills/prd/SKILL.md:125 -> "Build -> in `~/code/<slug>/` ..."
- docs/prd-authoring.md:16,29-31 -> "## The folder field is the join key /
  The PRD's `folder:` value MUST equal the directory name under `~/code/`."

Every consumer inherits this schema assumption:

- skills/prd/scripts/prd-new.mjs:194 -> prints "Folder join key: <folder> -> ~/code/<folder>/"
- scripts/prd-seed.mjs:17,114 -> CODE_DIR=path.join(os.homedir(),'code'); repoDir=path.join(CODE_DIR, fm.folder)
- scripts/prd-audit.mjs:9,24,101,102 -> CODE_DIR; fs.existsSync(path.join(CODE_DIR, fm.folder)); "not found at ~/code/<folder>" warning
- scripts/beads-dashboard.js:16,52,57,60,61 -> CODE_DIR=process.env.BEADS_CODE_DIR||path.join(HOME,'code'); enumerates CODE_DIR/* for .beads (already has a PARTIAL env override — the pattern to generalize)

This is NOT a context-gate problem (lib/is-code-context.js correctly does NOT
apply — there is no cwd to detect; these resolve a NAMED folder / enumerate a
directory). It is a configurable-projects-root problem.

## Required fix scope (do NOT implement yet — see Design notes)

1. Configurable projects root: introduce a shared BRAINY_PROJECTS_DIR
   (env + brainy setting), generalizing the existing BEADS_CODE_DIR override
   already in beads-dashboard.js, with a sane default and discovery. Consumed
   by prd-audit.mjs, prd-seed.mjs, scripts/beads-dashboard.js (and
   prd-new.mjs's printed guidance).
2. De-hardcode the PRD SCHEMA + skill/docs so the PRD<->repo join is defined
   abstractly (folder = the project repo dir under the configured projects
   root), NOT literally `~/code/<slug>`: update skills/prd/SKILL.md (lines 43,
   125), docs/prd-authoring.md (16, 29-31), and prd-new.mjs:194 wording.
3. Tests: verify the PRD<->repo join (prd-audit folder-exists check, prd-seed
   repoDir resolution, beads-dashboard project enumeration) works correctly
   with a projects root that is NOT ~/code, on a machine with no ~/code at all.

Also brings the previously-flagged settings-viewer/scripts/data/beads.mjs:25
(join(homedir(),'code')) + panels/beads.mjs:17 (user-facing "under ~/code"
string) under the same configurable-root fix.

References: supersedes the earlier P3 framing; sibling of cp-wp2 (hook sweep,
done) and R-1/cp-jt8 (git as required dependency). NOT the same class as
cp-d9g (session-auto-track transcript-dir ENCODING bug).
design: OWN FOCUSED PR — NOT folded into PR #12 (hooks). Do NOT start coding until the user explicitly approves the cp-qr9 plan (team lead will relay). The schema/docs change (item 2) is the riskiest part — it alters the PRD<->repo join contract, so it needs the test matrix (item 3) green for a non-~/code root before any merge. Suggested env/setting name: BRAINY_PROJECTS_DIR, generalizing BEADS_CODE_DIR (already in beads-dashboard.js:16). Keep ~/code only as the DEFAULT when nothing is configured (back-compat), never as a hard assumption.
close_reason: DONE — PR #14 (fix/projects-root-configurable, base master, NOT merged). Added scripts/lib/projects-root.js shared resolver (BRAINY_PROJECTS_DIR > BEADS_CODE_DIR > ~/code default). De-hardcoded all 5 consumers (prd-audit, prd-seed, beads-dashboard, prd-new, settings-viewer data+panels beads.mjs) AND the design-level root cause: PRD schema/docs (skills/prd/SKILL.md, docs/prd-authoring.md) — folder: is now a repo dir NAME resolved under the configured root, not a literal ~/code/<slug>. Tests: scripts/lib/projects-root.test.js 17 assertions incl. end-to-end PRD<->repo join through prd-audit against a non-~/code root + ~/code back-compat default; wired into brainy-self-test (new Unit tests section). self-test 104/0 exit 0. ~/code kept strictly as back-compat default.

title: brainy: encodeCwd skips spaces and periods
description: session-export-qmd.js encodeCwd() regex /[:\/]/g only replaced : \ /. Claude Code's actual encoding replaces ALL non-word characters with -, including spaces and periods. Any vault or repo path containing a space (e.g. 'Obsidian Vault') or period (e.g. '1. Projects') silently failed JSONL lookup → no transcripts ever exported for sessions running from those cwds. Fix: replace /[:\/]/g with /[^\w-]/g. Verified 5/5 real Claude-Code-encoded paths match.
close_reason: Shipped on fix branch. 5/5 path-encoding tests pass, live end-to-end verified.

title: brainy: ensure-obsidian.js spawn leaves Windows zombie processes
description: ensure-obsidian.js calls spawn(exe, [], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref() on Windows. Obsidian has a single-instance lock — second-instance spawns should message the first to focus, then exit cleanly. But the detached+no-stdio spawn pattern leaves the orphan running forever with no window (MainWindowHandle=0). Confirmed live: 5 Obsidian processes running, 1 with visible window (PID 32600 from 09:46), 1 orphan zombie (PID 3660 from 14:59 — when this Claude Code session started). Windows routes user taskbar clicks to the most recent process, which is the windowless zombie — clicks silently fail. Fix: on Windows use execSync('start "" "<exe>"') which delegates to the Windows shell and handles single-instance correctly. Test by killing existing zombies, running the hook, and verifying only one process remains.
close_reason: Shipped on fix/brainy-session-export-collisions. Kill-and-relaunch test verifies no zombie.

title: brainy: session-export-qmd.js collisions, threshold, and silent skips
description: session-export-qmd.js writes filename {date}-{slug}.md where slug defaults to 'session' — causes same-day cross-session collisions where the last Stop hook wins and clobbers earlier transcripts. Also drops sessions <4 msgs entirely (no log), and the dead-branch overwrite logic at lines 188-193 always writes regardless of the comment 'don't overwrite'. Fix: include sessionId.slice(0,8) in filename, drop threshold to 2, log every skip path with reason, write a small test that exports a synthetic JSONL and verifies the file lands correctly without colliding with a same-day same-slug second session.
close_reason: Shipped on fix/brainy-session-export-collisions. Test verifies no collision + skip logging. Self-test 100/100.

title: brainy: bd auto-init missing --external flag for shared-server mode
description: hooks/check-beads-init.js and scripts/prd-seed.mjs both ran 'bd init --shared-server' without --external. On Windows with the global shared Dolt server already running at ~/.beads/shared-server/, this fails silently: bd tries to start a second server on the bound port 3308 and bails mid-init, leaving a corrupt .beads/ dir. Root cause traced in beads source at internal/doltserver/doltserver.go IsRunning() which deletes pid/port files when Win32_Process probe doesn't confirm the process. Fixed by adding --external --non-interactive to both call sites and to setup.md workflow doc. Memory saved at feedback_bd_init_shared_server_external.md.
close_reason: Fixed in commit on chore/brainy-remove-wispr-granola — 3 brainy call sites + memory + setup workflow updated.

title: Brainy: MEMORY.md index drifts — memory-index-sync matches Write tool only; fix via FileChanged:MEMORY.md
description: HD-2.6 / HD-12.3. memory-index-sync.js is PostToolUse matcher 'Write' only -> a memory note added/changed via the Edit tool, Bash, the obsidian CLI, or an external Obsidian edit never triggers the MEMORY.md index sync -> MEMORY.md silently drifts from the *_*.md memory files. Fix mechanism: a FileChanged hook with matcher 'MEMORY.md' (and/or the memory dir) fires on the file changing however it changed — strictly better than broadening the tool matcher (also catches edits made outside Claude). Ledger HD-2.6 + HD-12.3.

title: Brainy: add CwdChanged hook — detect mid-session project-boundary crossing (session mis-attribution)
description: HD-12.2. Brainy anchors project at SessionStart via sessionDir() (cp-d9g/F-3.2) and treats later cwd as noise. Failure: cd from project A into project B and work there mid-session -> all of B's work attributed to A's session/note/beads scope indefinitely. Add a CwdChanged hook: compare findCodeRoot(new cwd) vs anchored sessionDir; if a different recognized project -> warn / open a new session note for B / offer re-anchor. title: check-git-init: no git-absence guard — emits 'git init failed' hook error instead of guiding install (R-1)
description:
LIVE-caught this session by the hook-watcher monitor:
  [brainy] Hook error in check-git-init: git init failed: 'git' is not recognized as an internal or external command

Root cause: check-git-init.js tryGitInit() (line 15) runs `execSync('git init -b main')` with NO check that git exists / is on PATH. When git is absent, execSync throws ENOENT/'not recognized'; the catch turns it into result.ok=false and the hook then logs `log.error(HOOK, git init failed: ...)` and writes a "git init failed" message — surfacing a confusing hook ERROR rather than the actionable "install git" guidance.

DISTINCT from the ~/code gate fix (that work is done): this is a git-PRESENCE robustness gap. R-1-adjacent — empirical proof that git is an unguarded hard assumption (see cp-jt8 / R-1, where git was made a required setup dependency with cross-platform install guidance). check-git-init.js should mirror check-beads-init.js: detect git absence FIRST (e.g. `git --version` probe or distinguish ENOENT/'not recognized' from a real init error), and on absence emit the R-1-style install guidance (winget/brew/apt) and exit 0 cleanly — NOT attempt `git init` and report a failure/throw a hook error.

References: R-1, cp-jt8 (git as required setup dependency). Track only; do NOT fix in PR #12 — separate non-blocking follow-up.
close_reason: Added isGitOnPath() probe (mirrors check-beads-init.js Step 1) + git-absence guard BEFORE any init attempt in check-git-init.js. On git missing: emits R-1-style cross-platform install guidance (winget/brew/apt/dnf) and exits 0 cleanly, never runs git init. Verified functionally: with git removed from PATH, hook prints 'Git Not Installed' guidance, exit 0, no 'git init failed' error.
